title: Mimi EP3 shiver to snug towel
prompt: Solo piano, light and gently playful at first like tiny shivering steps and a soft rolling wobble, around 76 BPM, soft staccato left hand and a simple curious melody in the middle register, then a small bittersweet dip in the middle as a little dog feels brave and cold, then a slow warm turn into a tender major-key lullaby like being wrapped in a fluffy towel, ending on a soft smiling final chord. The feeling of a family and their little dog understanding each other after a funny misunderstanding about a wet floor. Very restrained dynamics (pianissimo to mezzo-piano), steady middle register, no sudden loud notes and no busy high-register runs, so it can sit quietly under spoken dialogue. Solo piano only: no drums, no strings, no vocals, no synth pads, no sound effects.
